propositions: Tickets declaring file_impact_scope: none require deterministic validation that the declared assertion is correct before the assertion can silence drift protection
A new advisory LLM criterion no-file-impact must be routed only when persisted file_impact_scope equals 'none', never for 'paths', 'undeclared', missing/None/unknown values

The criterion must render a structured declared-reason context block into the Pass-1 request with deterministic JSON serialization, preserving exact persisted reason values including quotes/newlines/Unicode

Criterion judgment uses three sub-answer fields—assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named—where contradiction is returned if any repository file edit is required, pass if all deliverables are external, and insufficient coaching if evidence is too vague

Routing applicability, prompt input contract, criterion decision semantics, and advisory gate behavior must be verified through public observable contracts without implementation-source grep or private-shape assertions
